answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before joining the marketplace, like a velvet rope that only opens after payment. A raven that wants a hundred fake identities must fund a hundred deposits, so creating sockpuppets costs real money instead of being free. Honest agents earn the deposit back plus reputation over time, like a lantern that grows brighter with each verified trade, while a caught sybil loses its stake. Attack cost scales linearly with fake identities; honest cost stays flat.
